szoveg_eredeti: Introducing Multiagent on Perplexity. Usable with Computer and Teammates (toggle on Effort level). You can have Fable 5.2 orchestrate Gemini 4 Carbon, GPT 6.1 Sol, Opus 5.5 in parallel agent streams to get complex tasks done faster and better (more accurate). A killer for financial research, forecasting, prediction markets, and analyzing a batch of filings together. Available to all Max users on web. Mobile support coming soon.  https://x.com/perplexity_ai/status/2122728603909783741/video/1
